item: A hung test names itself; the .eml no-network test no longer hangs on Windows (row 93)
summary: OO_TEST_HANG_LIMIT_S arms faulthandler per test (600 s on the portability legs): past it every thread's traceback is written under the test's name and the run ends; the next step tells a hang from a cap-stop and lists tests slower than OO_TEST_SLOW_S. The watchdog named test_newsletters_import_endpoint_zero_network (Windows shard 1, run 43803278424): it replaced socket.socket outright, forbidding the event loop's own loopback sockets; it now refuses and records only connects/resolutions off loopback and asserts the record empty. Second Windows hang it named (shard 3): tests/test_export_job.py fed a whole locale table to node on stdin and node never returned; it now runs a UTF-8 file with a 120 s bound, like every other node test. Windows legs' cap 60 -> 90 min (shard 2 was at 49% at 60 min with no hang); the timer is re-armed after a failed phase (pytest's faulthandler plugin cancels it), and the variables are popped so a child pytest cannot empty the reports.
